_comment: Local secrets and test data for the one environment you test against. Run `make env-gettoken` after editing. This file is copied to example/config.local.json and is not tracked by Git. Private deployment is not a separate mode: set enablePrivateConfig to true and fill the server fields below. chatOptions only needs the keys the app should override: 4.25 supports appKey/autoLogin/debugMode/enableUserInfo/enableAutoSyncContacts/autoLoadConversations/enableChatroomConversation (dataSyncType belongs to 5.x and is ignored here).
